title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $300 on Shark AV2501AE AI
content_html:
SAVE $300: As of Sept. 7, the Shark AV2501AE AI robot vacuum is on sale for $299.99 at Amazon. That's a 50percent discount on the list price.

Credit: Shark

$299.99 at Amazon
$599.99 Save $300

Labor Day sales are here, and Amazon has dropped prices on hundreds of items across everything from tech to home furniture. The Shark AV2501AE AI robot vacuum has also seen a big drop, $300 of a drop to be precise. If you've been looking for an impressive model to handle your vacuuming, this deal might just sway you.

This robot vacuum benefits from Matrix Clean technology, meaning it takes multiple passes over messes in a precision grid pattern to ensure more thorough coverage. It also uses 360° LiDAR navigation to map your home and detect any obstacles in its way, even in the dark.

When the battery runs low, the robot automatically returns to its dock to recharge, then resumes cleaning where it left off. You'll get up to 90 minutes of runtime before it runs out, however. The bagless self-emptying base can hold up to 60 days' worth of dirt and debris, so there's no need for disposal bags. You can even schedule, start, or target cleaning through the SharkClean app, or use voice commands with Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant, so there's very minimal effort needed from you.
